content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Customizations ## slug: evbuilder-features-customizations ## seoTitle: Customizations ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End There are a couple ways that users can customize the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}. * Select fields from a predefined field set that excludes fields hard-coded into the Builder’s UI. * Add Standard, packaged, and custom fields to each section. :::(Info) (Important Functionality) Fields added to the field set will respect the required option as designated by field set or field metadata and not the page layout. ::: ## Customize Fields Fields can be added to the sections that allow customization. For this example, let’s place the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} field in the Event Details section. {{snippet.AddFieldToEventBuilder}}
